label: Spanish
provenance: Extracted with UCKeyTranslate on macOS against the input sources "ABC" and "Spanish" (the ISO board), 2026-09-14, by scripts/dump-layout.swift. Not written from memory.
warning: Spanish shares the Latin script with English and puts EVERY letter a-z in the same place. Only punctuation moves, so a wrong-layout mistake here mangles punctuation and nothing else: ma;ana for mañana. Recovery is possible only when the text contains one of the keys that differ, and impossible for accented vowels, which are dead-key sequences this model does not represent.
